items.name: JWT Auth
items.description: Validate and sign JWTs at the gateway edge. Supports HS256, RS256, and ES256 algorithms.
items.author: Rioku Labs

items.name: API Key Auth
items.description: Issue and validate API keys with scopes, expiry, and per-key rate limits.
items.author: Rioku Labs

items.name: Rate Limiter
items.description: Token-bucket and sliding-window rate limiting with Redis or in-memory counters.
items.author: Rioku Labs

items.name: OIDC / OAuth2
items.description: Full OpenID Connect relying-party with PKCE, token introspection, and session bridging.
items.author: Rioku Labs

items.name: CORS
items.description: Cross-origin resource sharing headers with per-route allow-list and preflight caching.
items.author: Rioku Labs

items.name: Circuit Breaker
items.description: Protect upstreams from cascading failures with half-open probes and configurable thresholds.
items.author: Rioku Labs

items.name: Traffic Mirror
items.description: Shadow-copy requests to a secondary upstream for testing and observability without affecting production.
items.author: Rioku Labs

items.name: Canary Releases
items.description: Gradual traffic shifting between upstream versions with header-based overrides.
items.author: Rioku Labs

items.name: Request/Response Transform
items.description: Header injection, body rewriting, and path rewriting via CEL expressions.
items.author: Rioku Labs
